description: Open a saved architecture review with a baseline diagram and a concrete review question. The liveUrl is a read capability; keep the returned resumeToken private so a later MCP connection can resume after disconnect or restart. Revisions, findings, decisions, and open questions persist atomically in ARC_REVIEW_DIR. Use begin_live_diagram_work, update_live_diagram, and finish_live_diagram_work for declared work; use update_architecture_review for evidence. Requires configured durable storage.

harness.description: Caller-declared harness label, for example Codex; not inferred or verified by Arc

question.description: The concrete architecture question this review will answer

name: open_architecture_review
